components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button in clinical navy with 4px architectural corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--color-primary, #1f3b57); color: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, sans-serif); font-size: var(--text-sm, 0.875rem); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover, #16293d); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #1f3b57); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary or cancel action with 1px hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d9dee4); background: transparent; color: var(--color-primary, #1f3b57); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, sans-serif); font-size: var(--text-sm, 0.875rem); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary, #1f3b57); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #1f3b57); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard 44px form field with navy focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, sans-serif); font-size: var(--text-sm, 0.875rem); font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink, #121826); } .ds-field-input { height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d9dee4); background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--color-ink, #121826); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, sans-serif); font-size: var(--text-base, 1rem); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary, #1f3b57); box-shadow: var(--focus-ring, 0 0 0 3px rgba(31, 59, 87, 0.25)); }

components.name: Home Action Card
components.description: Elevated white container with 1px hairline border and subtle ambient shadow.
components.html: Avaliações físicasHistórico antropométrico imutável e comparação lado a lado.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 24px; background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d9dee4); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card, 0 1px 2px rgba(18, 24, 38, 0.06), 0 8px 24px rgba(18, 24, 38, 0.06)); text-decoration: none; color: var(--color-ink, #121826); transition: border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary, #1f3b57); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #1f3b57); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--font-display, 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif); font-size: var(--text-lg, 1.125rem); font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-text { font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, sans-serif); font-size: var(--text-sm, 0.875rem); color: var(--color-ink-muted, #5b6472); line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact clinical status tag in copper-amber soft or clinical green.
components.html: AprovadaEm revisão
components.css: .ds-badges { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, sans-serif); font-size: var(--text-xs, 0.75rem); font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-badge--success { background: var(--color-success, #2f6e4c); color: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); } .ds-badge--muted { background: var(--color-accent-soft, #f3e3d1); color: var(--color-accent-ink, #8a4f12); border-color: var(--color-accent-ink, #8a4f12); }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Clinical data table with cool-paper uppercase headers and hairline row dividers.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d9dee4); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px); overflow-x: auto; box-shadow: var(--shadow-card, 0 1px 2px rgba(18, 24, 38, 0.06), 0 8px 24px rgba(18, 24, 38, 0.06)); } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, sans-serif); font-size: var(--text-sm, 0.875rem); } .ds-table th { text-align: left; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: var(--text-xs, 0.75rem); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #5b6472); background: var(--color-bg, #eef1f4); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d9dee4); } .ds-table td { padding: 12px 16px; color: var(--color-ink, #121826); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d9dee4); } .ds-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; } .ds-mono { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace); font-size: var(--text-xs, 0.75rem); }

narrative.overview:
ProCoach is built around the visual discipline of a clinical ledger: an instrument for evidence, immutable protocol versioning, and auditability. Rather than borrowing the loud, consumer-oriented tropes of generic fitness apps, the interface treats training plans, anthropometric assessments, and nutrition prescriptions as structured clinical records.

The system pairs a cool, high-legibility paper canvas with deep navy primary actions and restrained copper-amber accents reserved for active state indicators and version markers. Controls are precise and restrained—firm 4px and 8px geometry, crisp 1px borders, and fast 120ms transitions without decorative flourishes.
keyCharacteristics: Precision and restraint over decoration: every visual element serves scannability, data comparison, or state clarity.
Monospace typography is strictly reserved for real data (versions, timestamps, IDs, metrics) and never used as ornament.
Contained hybrid elevation: 1px hairline borders anchor the layout, supported by subtle ambient card shadows only on elevated containers, tables, and modals.
Zero external UI kits (no MUI or Chakra); all primitives live in src/components/ui and consume src/styles/tokens.css.

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: Copper-amber (copper-amber) is reserved strictly for active navigation indicators, version markers, and muted status badges—never for primary buttons or large surface fills.

rules.name: The Real-Data Mono Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono is used exclusively for real structured data (versions, IDs, timestamps, audit logs) and never as decorative styling on headings or marketing copy.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Structural hierarchy comes from 1px borders and surface contrast (cool-paper vs. pure-surface) first; --shadow-card is a quiet ambient lift for cards, tables, and modals, never a heavy drop shadow.

dos: Do reuse src/components/ui primitives and src/styles/tokens.css variables for every new screen.
Do preserve 44px minimum height on buttons, inputs, and mobile navigation links for reliable touch and desktop ergonomics.
Do use IBM Plex Mono only for real structured data (versions, IDs, timestamps, clinical metrics).
Do keep 1px hairline-border strokes and --shadow-card subtle so data density stays calm and readable.
donts: Don't introduce external UI kits (MUI, Chakra, etc.) or generic consumer-fitness aesthetics (neon gradients, heavily rounded pill cards, decorative illustrations).
Don't use copper-amber for primary CTAs or large background fills; keep it for active nav underlines, version markers, and muted badges.
Don't invent new radius, shadow, or font-family values outside tokens.css.
